 Pelicans visit Thunder in NBA Cup group stage | Watch on WDAM 7 ABC 
 By The Associated Press Published : Nov. 20, 2026 at 6:11 PM CST | Updated : 4 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google OKLAHOMA CITY, Okla. (WDAM) - The Oklahoma City Thunder face the New Orleans Pelicans in an NBA Cup in-season tournament group play matchup. 
 Friday’s matchup is the first this season between the teams. 
 Oklahoma City is 6-5 against the Western Conference, and New Orleans is 4-8 against conference opponents.
 WHO: New Orleans Pelicans (5-11, 12th in the Western Conference) vs. Oklahoma City Thunder (9-6, eighth in the Western Conference)
 WHERE: Oklahoma City; Friday, 7 p.m. CST
 ON TV: WDAM 7 ABC (Channel 7.2), Gulf Coast Sports and Entertainment Network
 BOTTOM LINE: The New Orleans Pelicans travel to face the New Orleans Pelicans in an NBA Cup in-season tournament group play matchup.
 The Thunder have gone 6-5 against Western Conference teams. Oklahoma City is 0-1 in games decided by less than 4 points.
 The Pelicans are 4-8 in conference play. New Orleans ranks second in the NBA, scoring 18.2 fast break points per game. Jeremiah Fears leads the Pelicans, averaging 3.9.
 The Thunder average 10.8 made 3-pointers per game this season, 2.8 fewer makes per game than the Pelicans allow (13.6). The Pelicans are shooting 46.1% from the field, 4.0% higher than the 42.1% the Thunder’s opponents have shot this season.
 TOP PERFORMERS: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander is averaging 31.1 points and 4.3 assists for the Thunder. Jared McCain is averaging 15.0 points over the last 10 games.
 Fears is scoring 15.6 points per game and averaging 4.9 rebounds for the Pelicans. Saddiq Bey is averaging 2.7 made 3-pointers over the last 10 games.
 LAST 10 GAMES: Thunder: 5-5, averaging 114.1 points, 45.9 rebounds, 23.8 assists, 8.1 steals and 4.7 blocks per game while shooting 47.3% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 109.3 points per game.
 Pelicans: 3-7, averaging 112.8 points, 40.5 rebounds, 23.5 assists, 7.3 steals and 5.3 blocks per game while shooting 43.8% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 125.8 points.
 INJURIES: Thunder: Cason Wallace: out (shoulder), Thomas Sorber: day-to-day (knee), Chet Holmgren: out (knee), Jalen Williams: out (ankle), Alex Caruso: day-to-day (hip), Nikola Topic: day-to-day (hip).
 Pelicans: Bryce McGowens: day-to-day (elbow), Dejounte Murray: day-to-day (ankle), Bennedict Mathurin: day-to-day (plantar), Trendon Watford: day-to-day (ankle), Trey Murphy III: day-to-day (knee).
